items.title: Sam Darnold: Still tracking toward Week 12 start
items.text:
Head coach Mike Macdonald said Monday that Darnold (quadriceps/rib) made a "good bit of progress" over the Seahawks' Week 11 bye and will start Sunday at San Francisco if he fares well during Wednesday's practice, Brady Henderson of ESPN.com reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Antonio Williams: Career-best totals in win
items.text:
Williams brought in nine of 11 targets for 122 yards in the Commanders' 22-20 win over the Bengals on Monday night.

items.title: Jacory Croskey-Merritt: Scores TD in return from injury
items.text:
Croskey-Merritt rushed 13 times for 54 yards and a touchdown and brought in two of three targets for 23 yards in the Commanders' 22-20 win over the Bengals on Monday night.

items.title: Chase Brown: Forgettable rushing night in loss
items.text:
Brown rushed six times for six yards and brought in five of eight targets for 30 yards in the Bengals' 22-20 loss to the Commanders on Monday night.

items.title: Stefon Diggs: Four catches in Week 11 win
items.text:
Diggs brought in four of six targets for 45 yards in the Commanders' 22-20 win over the Bengals on Monday night.
